description: By the end of 2026, AI capital expenditure is projected to hit nearly $700 billion. The question isn’t who has the best model, but who has the most creative financing to build out AI infrastructure and beyond. Sarah Guo is joined by Neil Tiwari, Managing Director at Magnetar Capital, a financial innovator helping the AI industry scale from billions to trillions of dollars in CapEx. Neil explains some of the debt structures used to finance massive GPU clusters, who is taking the risk, and how the…
classificationReason: The interview includes a dedicated discussion of physical-AI capital needs within broader AI infrastructure financing.
qualityReason: Detailed first-hand discussion of AI infrastructure financing, collateral, power constraints, inference economics, and physical-AI capital needs, though robotics is only a brief closing topic.
